note: Per-library email-to-print. No central directory exists; each library publishes its own code on its own site. Verified from library websites; extend by pull request. The agent also resolves unknown libraries live at job time.
pattern: Usually <stem>-bw@ewprints.com (b&w) and <stem>-color@ewprints.com (color); some libraries deviate (dots, -legal, -duplex). Send the PDF, a release code returns by email, release at the library.
